observed_problem: Core v2 authority does not state strongly enough that ChatGPT is the primary research/editorial operator. WU-010R/WU-011 orchestration consequently models each local editorial stage as an externally controlled action requiring Action Spec, Handoff Request, Handoff, Result and Validation Attestation ceremony even though ChatGPT itself prepares the authoritative stage artifacts.
expected_behavior: Repository policy should make ChatGPT the reasoning/editorial operator and treat scripts/workflows as supporting tools. Local research/editorial stages should require only the canonical stage artifacts, applicable deterministic validation and the minimum checkpoint record necessary for resume/provenance. Rich request/receipt control is reserved for true external or irreversible boundaries.
actual_behavior: Core authority, AGENTS.md and session bootstrap now make ChatGPT the primary operator. scripts/survey_agent_control_v2.py and the production-control workflow use one compact Stage Checkpoint per local lifecycle transition; legacy Action/Handoff machinery remains compatibility/audit code rather than the canonical hot path. Release keeps dedicated external-side-effect control.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented by WU-012A/B: ChatGPT-first operating authority plus compact Stage Checkpoint orchestration; richer external control remains only where it provides distinct safety.
